title: Tenure Addition on Credit Builder Accounts Goodwill Credits
content:
The goodwill share applied to a Credit Builder late fee grows with how long the account has been open.

## Tenure bands

An account open 24 months or more adds the long-tenure addition; an account open at least 12 but fewer than 24 months adds the tenure addition; an account open fewer than 12 months adds nothing for tenure; months open are whole calendar months from the open date, each complete on the day of the month matching the opening day or, in a month too short for that day, on the first day of the following month.

The open date is the date the account activated, shown on the account record.

| Whole months open | Added to the goodwill share |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | long-tenure addition: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| 12 to 23 | tenure addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| fewer than 12 | 0.0, nothing added |

## Month counts (hypothetical dates)

An account opened 5 June has 11 whole months open on 4 June of the next year and 12 on 5 June; 23 on 4 June two years after opening and 24 on 5 June that year.
